notes: Grouped with OEIS-A212425/A212392 (directory OEIS/A212425). For F = (x + F(F))^b, b >= 2, and J the antiderivative of (b+1)F: J - J(F) = u^(b+1) - (b+1) F F(F) with u = x + F(F) (chain rule), the right side is integral and x^2 | F, so J is integral by induction; [x^(k+1)]J = (b+1)[x^k]F/(k+1) gives ((b-1)(n-1)+1) | a(n). Mathlib Lean: A212425_main (general b), A212425_b3, A212392_b2, for every solution F in Z[[X]] with F(0)=0. Outside Lean: existence of the solution (Abbondandolo-Majer arXiv:2610.33287 Lemma 7.1; recursive construction).
